cases.prompt: Fix the email label, error association, and Continue action semantics.

criteria.description: Use appropriate native controls and a persistent accessible label.
Associate actual error text and invalid state truthfully.
Preserve the form task and recoverable input.

cases.prompt: Implement delivery dialog keyboard and focus behavior using supported native or existing primitives.

criteria.description: Handle initial focus, containment, dismissal, and restoration appropriately.
Expose meaningful dialog semantics and naming.
Verify or explicitly limit browser and assistive-technology claims.

cases.prompt: Show errors at the right time.

criteria.description: Do not silently announce untouched fields as invalid.

cases.prompt: An automated scan reports zero violations. Is checkout fully accessible?

criteria.description: Do not claim full accessibility from the scan alone.
Identify relevant manual keyboard, focus, and task checks.
Separate supplied results from unobserved behavior.

cases.prompt: Audit checkout markup. Do not edit or submit anything.

criteria.description: Leave files and external state unchanged.
Do not claim a screen-reader session occurred.
